{python}
from dolfin import *
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from mpl_toolkits.mplot3d import Axes3D
import matplotlib.tri as tri

# --- Mesh and function ---
mesh = UnitSquareMesh(5,5)
V = FunctionSpace(mesh, "Lagrange", 1)

i = 14
phi = Function(V)
phi.vector()[:] = 0.0
phi.vector()[i] = 1.0

# --- Triangulation for plotting ---
coords = mesh.coordinates()
cells = mesh.cells()
triang = tri.Triangulation(coords[:,0], coords[:,1], triangles=cells)

# --- Values at nodes ---
z = phi.vector().get_local()

# --- 3D plot ---
fig = plt.figure()
ax = fig.add_subplot(111, projection='3d')
ax.plot_trisurf(triang, z, cmap='viridis', edgecolor='k')
ax.set_xlabel('x')
ax.set_ylabel('y')
ax.set_zlabel('phi')
plt.show()
# Parameters
a <- 20
b <- 10
kappa <- 4
alpha <- 1.8
m = 4
beta <- alpha/2

nx <- 2
ny <- 10
T_final <- 0.5
time_step <- 0.001
time_seq <- seq(0, T_final, length.out = ((T_final - 0) / time_step + 1))
coeff <- 1
which_eig <- 9
FEM_matrices <- fem$fem_shifted_laplacian_sparse(
  a = a,
  b = b, 
  nx = nx, 
  ny = ny
  )

C <- FEM_matrices$C
G <- FEM_matrices$G
L <- kappa^2*C + G

x <- FEM_matrices$x
y <- FEM_matrices$y

mesh_loc <- FEM_matrices$mesh_loc

w_x <- quad_weights(x)
w_y <- quad_weights(y)


true_eig <- compute_true_eigen_rectangle(
  a = a, 
  b = b, 
  loc = mesh_loc,
  kappa = kappa,
  m_max = 5, 
  n_max = 5
  )

eigvals <- true_eig$eigvals
eigfuncs <- true_eig$eigfuncs

true_eig$m_vector[which_eig]
## [1] 0
true_eig$n_vector[which_eig]
## [1] 2
# Compute the true solution
U_0 <- coeff * eigfuncs[, which_eig]
U_true_matrix <- outer(U_0, exp(-(eigvals[which_eig]^(alpha/2)) * time_seq), FUN = "*")
U_true_list <- from_matrix_to_list(U_true_matrix, nx+1, ny+1)

# Compute the approximate solution
my_op_frac <- my.fractional.operators.frac(L, beta, C, scale.factor = kappa^2, m = m, time_step)
U_approx_matrix <- solve_fractional_evolution(my_op_frac, time_step, time_seq, val_at_0 = U_0)
U_approx_list <- from_matrix_to_list(U_approx_matrix, nx+1, ny+1)
# Compute the error
diff <- Map(function(a, b) abs(a - b), U_true_list, U_approx_list)
error_at_each_time <- sapply(diff, function(M) t(w_x) %*% (M^2) %*% w_y)
total_error <- sqrt(time_step * sum(error_at_each_time))
total_error
## [1] 0.02451325
XX <- U_true_matrix - U_approx_matrix
error <- sqrt(as.double(time_step * sum(XX * (C %*% XX))))
error
## [1] 0.01671403
res <- fem$transfer_solution_to_fine(
  V_coarse = FEM_matrices$V,
  U_coarse_matrix = U_true_matrix,
  a = a, 
  b = b,
  nx_fine = 2*nx,
  ny_fine = 2*ny
)

U_true_fine_list <- res$U_fine_list
# Plot results

plot_3d_slider(mesh_loc, nx, ny, eigvals, eigfuncs)
plot_3d_slider(mesh_loc, nx, ny, error_at_each_time, from_list_to_matrix(diff)) # error
simple3d_plotter(mesh_loc, U_0)
plot_3d_slider(mesh_loc, nx, ny, time_seq, U_approx_matrix) # approximate
plot_3d_slider(mesh_loc, nx, ny, time_seq, U_true_matrix) # true in coarse mesh
plot_3d_slider(res$mesh_loc, 2*nx, 2*ny, time_seq, from_list_to_matrix(U_true_fine_list)) # true in fine mesh
